review.raw: All nine main deltas were compared as resolved ABC instructions. Removing inserted instructions, restoring the one numeric operand and relocating branch/exception instruction indices reproduces the previous bodies. All original pool prefixes, main interfaces and root bindings remain intact.
review.helpers: All 205 added helper bodies have valid raw branch offsets and exception boundaries and remain byte-identical in the adapted client. Sentinel form gating, guild raid UI/packets, Neo quest UI/packets, map teleport and loot command handling remain upstream code. Existing helpers are unchanged.
review.clocks: Guild gate motion, rest/quest deadlines and request cooldowns use elapsed time. The upstream cosmetic quest title, marker and prompt effects also contain frame-counted animations; this release leaves those instructions intact. Automatic native timelines retain the separately qualified ceiling.
review.preservation: All nine changed main envelopes and every non-main input tag are retained. The complete existing presentation adapter passes unchanged. No game, packet, authentication or loot-award method is replaced by this release.
